scopes.why: Create Razorpay orders server-side (POST /v1/orders with HTTP Basic auth) when the app calls useCheckout().createCheckout(); the key secret is resolved per-request and never reaches the browser. Only the public keyId is returned for the client Checkout widget.
Verify inbound Razorpay webhook signatures (the 'x-razorpay-signature' hex HMAC-SHA256 header) with the webhook secret so payment events are processed only when authentic.
